[PREFERENCE] User wants to make a difference in their community.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for making the food drive and sandwich-making station successful, including:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Partnering with a local food bank, promoting the food drive, setting up a collection system, specifying types of donations, and encouraging kid involvement.
